children: Overview
France AI-powered retail solutions provider's H1 adjusted revenue grew 29% yr/yr to €839 mln
Adjusted EBITDA for H1 rose 48% yr/yr to €160 mln
Company plans new share buyback mandate after completing previous €30 mln program
Outlook
Vusion confirms 2026 adjusted revenue growth guidance of 15% to 20% at constant exchange rates
Company expects around 40% growth in VAS revenue for 2026
Vusion expects over 100 basis points improvement in adjusted EBITDA margin in 2026
Result Drivers
VAS GROWTH - Co said 39% increase in VAS revenue, including 73% growth in recurring VAS, was driven by expansion of solutions portfolio and strong innovation momentum
AMERICAS MOMENTUM - Co attributed strong Americas revenue growth to successful EdgeSense deployment at Walmart and new projects with major U.S. retailers
PROFITABILITY IMPROVEMENT - Co said higher variable cost margin and favorable revenue mix, with VAS accounting for 15% of revenue, boosted adjusted EBITDA margin
